name: keynote-product
about: Apple's product keynote board (iPhone 14 Pro, September 2022): a 16:9 slide of 21 tiles, the product photo filling the centre hero, a wide tile above it and three below, and two columns of small tiles on each side with a wide statement band between them. Measured from the slide and scaled to 2000 px. Margins and gaps 20.

L1a.role: small: a visual with the label under it

L2a.role: small statement: two words in colour

L1b.role: small: label on top, a product detail cropped below

L2b.role: small: a chip or part, as an object

LW1.role: wide statement: one feature name in big coloured type

L1c.role: tall small: label on top, a big icon

L2c.role: tall small: label on top, an accessory or object

CT.role: wide, above the hero: label on top, three screens bleeding off the bottom

HERO.role: hero: the product photo or render, filling the tile

CB1.role: bottom: a UI detail with a two-line label under it

CB2.role: bottom centre: a big figure with its label under it (48MP)

CB3.role: bottom: a visual with the label under it

R1a.role: stat: a coloured figure over a two-line caption

R1b.role: tall small: label on top, a screen or photo below

R2b.role: tall small: label on top, the product colours

RW2.role: wide statement with a small eyebrow (New 12MP / Ultra Wide)

R1c.role: small: label on top, an object below

R2c.role: small: a photo with the label over it
